sloka: सुपर्णपृष्ठे स बभौ श्यामः पीताम्बरो हरिः ।काञ्चनस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे सतडित्तोयदो यथा ।। ७.६.६६ ॥
transliteration: suparṇapṛṣṭhe sa babhau śyāmaḥ pītāmbaro hariḥ ।kāñcanasya gireḥ śṛṅge sataḍittoyado yathā ।। 7.6.66 ॥

translations.english: That army of the Rakshasa king, with its banners scattered by the wind from Garuda's wings, fluttering flags, and scattered weapons, trembled like a blue mountain king with dislodged rocks.
